name: AstroImageJ
description: Updater checks SHA-256 and verifies a Sigstore keyless signature bound to a hardcoded GitHub Actions workflow identity — survives a compromised download server. (Dead legacy plaintext-HTTP updater exists but is unwired.)
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Targeted retained-source read supports the narrow Tier A behavior for this primary application updater: AstroImageJ computes the downloaded file hash, parses the detached Sigstore bundle, and verifies it with a Fulcio identity constraint pinned to the repository workflow.
limitations: The retained snapshot does not establish current released artifact signing or deployment state beyond the checked-in pinned key/configuration.
Framework verification depends on the packaged updater implementation where the application delegates to Sparkle or tauri-plugin-updater.

trust_root: Sigstore trust root + pinned GH Actions identity
